moduleEvaluation.description: Board F-J evaluation of 5 admin modules. Weighted scoring: Question Management 25%, Challenge 20%, Investigations 25%, Sessions 15%, Recommendations 15%.

questionManagement.rationale: Single-CLI question lookup returns 9-section dossier. 2,540 QIDs indexed. Health scoring complete (mean: 95). Certification history traceable. S259: 100% retrieval. S261 Scenario D: 4/4 certification timelines reconstructed.

challengeManagement.rationale: 35 challenges registered with bidirectional QID links. 35/35 triaged (post-S258). Classification: 20 LIKELY_DEFECT, 3 NEEDS_REVIEW. Investigation auto-create operational. S261 Scenario A: 4/4 challenge→recommendation chains complete.

investigationWorkflows.rationale: 19 investigations with valid state machine (OPEN→INVESTIGATING→ACTION_REQUIRED→RESOLVED→CLOSED). 0 broken FK references. Lifecycle spans CHALLENGE, DEFECT, GOVERNANCE, SYSTEMATIC types. S261 Scenario B: 2/2 defect investigations traced through lifecycle. Minor gap: 7 investigations still at OPEN (seeded, not yet activated).

sessionIntelligence.rationale: 40 sessions, 535 unique QIDs linked, 1,163 total references. 0 orphan QID refs. Bidirectional indexes maintained. Session→QID and QID→session lookup operational. 0 duplicate entries post-S253.

recommendationTracking.rationale: 5 REC-IDs with 2,482 QID target links. Severity tiering (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM). Status tracking (4 Open, 1 Resolved). S260: 0 orphan recommendation→QID references. Minor gap: 4 REC-IDs still Open (no closure timeline).

dimensionEvaluation.description: Board K-O evaluation across 4 dimensions. Weighting: Reliability 30%, Data Integrity 30%, Operational Readiness 25%, Expansion 15%.

reliability.rationale: S254 stress tests: all 6 engines PASS. Mean health score 95. 0 CRITICAL items. Error handling correct for edge cases (invalid QID, empty args, R-series, QID not found). Governance guard 32/32 PASS throughout all 10 sessions. Certified count stable at 2,298 — zero drift.

dataIntegrity.rationale: S259: 100% entity retrieval, 0 orphan lookups. S260: 0 broken relationships across 3,793 verified FKs. S258: All 4 gaps closed, 0 garbage registry refs. S253: Deep-links verified 5/5. Registry files parse consistently across all 10 sessions.
evidence: S258: 0 garbage refs, all state reconciled

operationalReadiness.rationale: S261: 11/11 cases (100%) across 4 scenarios. 0 manual report searches. All workflows completed through registries and engines alone. Admin can investigate questions, challenges, defects, governance events, and certification timelines without raw file traversal.

futureExpansionCapacity.rationale: Architecture is extensible: new engines can register with same CLI pattern. Student data bridge designed (S255) with canonical record schema, import/export contracts, privacy controls, and governance integration. Dashboard backend (S260) uses declarative schema — frontend can consume without backend changes. Gap: student performance data population requires operational learner activity before analytics become meaningful. This is deferred scope per S257.
evidence: S252: Admin data contract with RBAC roles
